translationRepairs: Zhu Shang was succeeded by Zhu Yan, who lost his title in Yongyuan 14 when his brother Zhu Bo was implicated in Empress Yin's witchcraft affair as her grandson by a daughter.

The Chinese 兄伯 specifies that Bo was Zhu Yan's elder brother; the idiomatic rendering drops 'elder'.
